calc.title: Calories & macros
calc.intro: Your daily targets come from these numbers. Change anything and the results update right away.
calc.setupHint: Bulkify needs your body data and goal to work out your daily calories, protein, carbs and fat. You can change them any time in Settings.

act.veryActiveHint: Very hard training or a physical job

calc.bmrHint: Calories your body burns at complete rest
calc.tdeeHint: Calories you burn with your activity
calc.fillInHint: Your calories and macros appear here as soon as every field is valid.

tip.cut: Aim to lose 0.5–1% of body weight per week. If progress stalls for 2 weeks, lower calories by 100–150.
tip.bulk: Aim to gain 0.25–0.5% of body weight per week. If you gain faster, lower calories by 100–150.
tip.maintain: Keep your weight within about 1 kg of today. If it drifts for 2 weeks, adjust calories by 100–150.

calc.disclaimer: These are estimates, not medical advice. Under 18 or with a health condition, consult a doctor or dietitian.

warn.minorCut: You are under 18: talk to a doctor before cutting calories.

targets.rangeHint: Each target is the middle of your range. Anything between the minimum (90%) and the maximum (110%) counts as on target.
